Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
Building AI/ML features to evaluate document quality, account loyalty, market trends, etc.
Constructing supervised learning datasets
Writing robust and testable code

Willingness to learn new things and engage with detailed data analysis
Openness to collaboration, flexibility in workflow, and ability to work well in a team
BS in Computer Science, Statistics, or Applied Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience
Around 2 years of experience in software development, statistical modeling, and machine learning, or an equivalent combination of education and experience

Familiarity with SQL or other querying languages
